editorial.marketInterpretation: The confirmed Friday selloff, especially chip underperformance, favors a defensive bearish baseline. Reported VIX near 37 and weak breadth reinforce risk aversion, although the observations are not tick-aligned. Reuters' 10Y near 4.93% cannot be paired with a stale 2Y as a fresh curve; the old 4.94% versus 4.65% yields imply +29 bp, not 0.29 bp. Current VXN, FedWatch and matched oil quotes are unverified. A headline's expected impact is not proof it caused the price action.
editorial.threeDayPath: Monday November 23 tests whether Friday's liquidation continues or gives way to an oversold rebound, with preliminary PMI data a possible catalyst. Tuesday November 24 brings Analog Devices, Dell and other earnings whose market impact remains unknown. Wednesday November 25 includes concentrated PCE/GDP and other macro releases plus the Beige Book, creating substantial two-way risk ahead of Thanksgiving. Avoid numerical targets without synchronized prices.
editorial.bullCase: An oversold bounce could develop if QQQ and SOX/SMH stabilize together, market breadth turns less negative and VIX/VXN retreat. Lower Treasury yields could provide duration relief but did not establish a Friday equity reversal.
editorial.bearCase: A sustained semiconductor-led liquidation, elevated volatility and weak breadth could extend losses into Monday and Tuesday. Earnings or macro surprises could exacerbate downside, but these are future conditional scenarios rather than observed reactions.
editorial.watchNext: Verify Monday's synchronized QQQ, Nasdaq, SOX/SMH, breadth, VIX/VXN, primary 10Y and 2Y yields, CME FedWatch and matched Brent/WTI futures. Track PMI, Analog Devices/Dell earnings, Wednesday PCE/GDP and Fed Beige Book, plus any new curated Open Watch catalyst.
